input.subject: Conservatory back door lock – Flat 22, 148 Lantern Quay (Ref R/PM021-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 22, 148 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ4 1ZZ – Ref R/PM021-1

Thank you for reporting the snapped key for the conservatory back door. Your landlord has approved a locksmith to replace the lock and supply new keys, and we are now arranging a contractor, who will contact you to agree a time to attend.

So we can judge how quickly this needs to happen, could you please confirm whether the door is currently locked and secure, or whether it can't be locked at the moment (and whether part of the key is stuck in the lock)? Please also let us know your availability for access.

If the door cannot be secured, please don't force the lock; keep the conservatory's internal door locked if possible and call the office straight away so we can arrange urgent attendance.

We will be back in touch by the end of tomorrow with the contractor's details.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
